UPDATE series SET last_matched_count = (
               SELECT COUNT(*) FROM files f
               JOIN issues i ON f.issue_id = i.id
               WHERE i.series_id = series.id
                 AND f.status = 'owned' AND f.is_present = 1
           )
           WHERE (
               SELECT COUNT(*) FROM files f
               JOIN issues i ON f.issue_id = i.id
               WHERE i.series_id = series.id
                 AND f.status = 'owned' AND f.is_present = 1
           ) > 0
